Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs - follow up & next steps

Thanks again for the time today, Jamie - good call. Quick recap + next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary workload: real-time generation for OliveAI chat assistant (customer-facing).
- Expected steady-state: ~150M tokens / month (rough ballpark).
- Traffic shape: regional US traffic, peak concurrency ~60-80 concurrent requests, sustained QPS ~15-25 during daytime peak.
- Average response size: ~200 tokens; some long-form responses up to ~1k tokens but rare.
- Latency SLO: p95 first-token < 300ms is the goal.

Questions we still need to close pricing/size:
1) Confirm target unit economics: you mentioned $80-100 / 1M tokens as a target - is $90 / 1M an acceptable midpoint to model?
2) Any strong GPU preference (H100 for latency vs A100 for cost)?
3) Procurement timeline / billing preference (monthly reserved vs annual commit)?

Next steps (proposed)
- If you confirm the numbers above I'll loop in Marcus (SE) to propose two configuration options (latency-first and cost-first) with throughput estimates and an initial price range.
- I've attached a short Dedicated_Reqs_Worksheet to capture peak windows, model sizes, and retention requirements - can you fill and return?
- We can schedule a 30-minute technical review with your infra/procurement next week to go over SLA and contract items.

Thanks - I'll draft up the config options after your confirmation.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs - initial sizing options

Appreciate the quick replies, Jamie - great to have the procurement timeline. I attached the worksheet and a very rough SOW draft. Marcus, can you weigh in on the two options below and give throughput / latency expectations?

Option A - Latency first (recommended for p95 < 300ms)
- Configuration: 2x NVIDIA H100-80GB (reserved), private VPC deployment, pinned model version.
- Expected headroom: handles peak bursts up to ~5k tokens/sec with autoscale burst; sustained throughput ~2k tokens/sec.
- Anticipated p95 first-token: ~150-300ms depending on sequence length and attention optimization.
- Pricing guidance (very rough): models + infra + support -> target $95 - $110 / 1M tokens.

Option B - Cost-first (recommended if budget constrained)
- Configuration: 4x NVIDIA A100-80GB (reserved), cost-optimized batching and quantization.
- Expected headroom: sustained throughput ~3k tokens/sec, peak bursts ~6k tokens/sec with reserved burst pools.
- Anticipated p95 first-token: ~220-420ms (long sequences see higher p95).
- Pricing guidance (very rough): models + infra + support -> target $75 - $90 / 1M tokens.

Notes: final unit economics depend on model size (FP16 vs quantized), KV cache hit rates, and how much prefix caching we can leverage. Marcus - please add any adjustments to throughput numbers / assumptions.

If either option looks reasonable we can model a 30-day pilot (metered) to validate costs and token profiles before committing to a 6/12 month reserved contract.

 - 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie@olive-ai.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs - technical sizing note

Thanks - jumping in with the technical assumptions and a short cost calc so the team has something concrete to work off. I kept math conservative.

Assumptions:
- Model: 70B decoder-only (similar to your production model); FP16 baseline, quantized option reduces memory and improves throughput ~1.4x.
- Avg response tokens: 200; 5% long-form at ~1k tokens.
- Latency target measured at first-token p95.

Per-GPU throughput rough numbers (in our runtime):
- H100-80GB: ~1.2k - 1.6k tokens/sec sustained (FP16), up to ~2.2k tokens/sec with quantization and KV cache hit. p95 first-token ~120-250ms for 200-token responses.
- A100-80GB: ~800 - 1.1k tokens/sec sustained (FP16), up to ~1.6k tokens/sec with quantization + cache. p95 first-token ~180-350ms for 200-token responses.

Sizing notes (mapping to OliveAI numbers):
- Target sustained tokens/sec for 150M tokens/month = (150e6 tokens / 30 days) / 86400 = ~58 tokens/sec. Peak safety factor 5x -> design for ~300 tokens/sec sustained during peak windows.
- To cover peak bursts to ~5k tokens/sec (short windows) you need burst capacity + autoscale; reserved baseline covers sustained load.

Recommended starting configs:
- Cost-first: 4x A100-80GB reserved. Sustained capacity ~3.2k - 4.4k tokens/sec aggregate (FP16), gives comfortable headroom for day-to-day and some burst handling when combined with burst pool. Expected unit economics in our bill model: ~$78 / 1M tokens (assuming 70% cache hit and quantized model).
- Latency-first: 2x H100-80GB reserved. Sustained capacity ~2.4k - 3.2k tokens/sec aggregate (FP16), much lower p95. Expected unit economics: ~$92 / 1M tokens (higher infra cost but better latency).

Why the numbers differ from the naive per-month calc: reserved infra costs + fixed support + private network egress amortize into the per-1M price. Quantization and caching are the main levers to push unit cost down.

Pilot suggestion: 30-day pilot on a 2-node A100 config with an opt-in burst pool to validate real token shape. If p95 numbers are too high we can switch to H100 for the production commit.

Next steps:
- Jamie: once you return the worksheet I'll run a model-specific sizing calc and attach a more detailed TCO spreadsheet.
- Marissa: can you confirm procurement constraints (monthly vs annual)? I can include both in the TCO.
